name: Starter Pack (example)
author: 272 Solutions
description: A worked example showing everything a Qivreno plugin pack can add: agent roles, a one-click team, a Library document, and a suggested MCP tool server.

agents.name: Grants
agents.description: Finds and writes grant applications — eligibility checks, narratives, budgets, and submission checklists.

teams.label: Grant Desk
teams.description: One role focused on funding applications end to end.

mcp_servers.name: filesystem
mcp_servers.description: Read and write files in a folder you choose. Replace /tmp with the folder you want agents to reach.
